calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, subtract the same-date cross-sectional median of its trailing seven-trading-day close return and reverse-sign the residual. Scale by lagged 20-day daily-return volatility. The signal is computed using only completed prior-day data and is intended to capture short-horizon idiosyncratic reversal, normalized for risk.

validation.regime_notes: Daily gate passed. Regime checks: 2020-2022 IC 0.03636 / ICIR 0.10703 (507 dates); 2023-2024 IC 0.01980 / ICIR 0.06169 (257 dates); 2025-2026 IC 0.03289 / ICIR 0.10512 (505 dates). IC is positive in all reported regimes, though the middle regime is less stable. Five- and ten-day decay is weak/negative, so use as a short-horizon signal only.
